y_definition: structure_direction(m1, '5m'): completed 5m = resample_ohlc left-closed open-time; tp = (H+L+C)/3; y = sign(tp[next_open] - tp[current_open]); current_open = 1m_open.floor('5min'); next_open = current_open + 5min; missing bar or exact-zero move → NaN, dropped, never class 0. y_5m_dir is an alias of y_5m (same array).
row_set_note: same 117,598 test bars as prior 5m logistic run

close_to_close.definition: sign(close[next 5m] - close[this 5m]); ties dropped; not stored as y_5m_dir

placebo.definition: y_placebo[t] = y_5m_dir[t+1] when next 5m bar is exactly 5 minutes later (sign of B_{t+2} vs B_{t+1})

shuffle.definition: permute train y_5m_dir in blocks of 12 consecutive 5m rows; X order unchanged; test y real
